title: Say Boses Kontrad Saray Palson Timbang
intro: Sakey a matoor a kamarerwa so binmaleg ed limog na saray negosyante tan negosyante ed dalin a saray timbangan so inkiling tan saray sukat so pinatikeyan. Sayan indibidual so inmalagey a bukor sumpad ag-inkamatoor na interon bansa, ya tinawag to ra ed inkahustisya tan panagdayew ed Sakey a Tuan Dios. Anggaman malinew so mensahe tan duga so tawag, ag-inmabuloy iray totoo ya ondengel tan nipaarap ira ed makapasinagem a kapalaran. Nabidbir mo kasi iyan mablin mensahero manlapud Quran?
clues: Nibaki ak bilang mensahero ed saray totoon say panagbilay da et manlalapud panaglako tan komersyo.
Kabkabat ed intiron bansa iray totook lapud pangiiter day antikey a sukat tan panagpalikdo ed panagtimbang.
Tinakotan da met iray manbiabiahe ed karsada tan ikakayat da met so karawalan ed interon mundo.
Pinaseseg ko ran mandayew ed si Allah labat tan magmaliw iran sigpot a matua ed pidedeneng da ed arum.
Ag da inawat so mensahek tan tinaktakot dan paekalen da ak tan saray kaibak a mananisia ed bansa.
Siak tan saray patumbok ko so inliktar nen Allah lapud panangasi To, bangta saray managgaway mauges so narel na makapasinagem a dusa.

trial.label: Say Kasalanan na Baley Ko
options: Panloko ed saray timbang tan sukat
Mangipaalagey na atagey a tori ya sumpad tawen
Mankekerew na kabatyan a kamelyo manlapud sakey a bato
Pinapatey to ray propita ya imbaki ed sikara
Iponpon ya mabilay iray ugugaw a bibii
trial.answer: Panloko ed saray timbang tan sukat

outcome.label: Say Kasumpalan Da
options: Sakey a makapasinagem ya eyag so sinmabi ed sikara nen labi
Sakey a maksil a delap so amalereg ed sikaran amin
Dineral ira na maksil ya ambetel a dagem
Saray bato ya gawad pitek so inuran ed sikara
outcome.answer: Sakey a makapasinagem ya eyag so sinmabi ed sikara nen labi

arabic: وَلَمَّا جَآءَ أَمْرُنَا نَجَّيْنَا شُعَيْبًۭا وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مَعَهُۥ بِرَحْمَةٍۢ مِّنَّا وَأَخَذَتِ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ ٱلصَّيْحَةُ فَأَصْبَحُوا۟ فِى دِيَـٰرِهِمْ جَـٰثِمِينَ
verse: And when Our command came, We saved Shuʿayb and those who believed with him, by mercy from Us. And the shriek seized those who had wronged, and they became within their homes [corpses] fallen prone (11:94)
